_doc: #336: B3 issuer codes (ISIN characters 3-6, e.g. BRBBDCACNPR8 -> BBDC) that CVM's FCA securities table (fca_cia_aberta_valor_mobiliario, 2010 on) cannot map to a CNPJ, because the issuer delisted before 2010 or its FCA rows have no trading code. Each root here was read from the BCB IF.data register name (entity_history/cadastro snapshots), never typed from memory. The FCA-derived codes are built at run time and need no entry. Foreign banks' BDRs (Santander SA, Citigroup, HSBC Holdings, US banks) are out of scope: their price is not a Brazilian institution's. Unibanco Holdings (UBHD) is left out: a non-bank holding with no IF.data entry.
